scientific_question: Can one unrestricted depth-shared MLP base restore the globally coordinated field omitted by layer-private 2:4 matrices while the sparse residual supplies the private feature boundaries and residual writes that shared trunks lack?

causal_basis.finding: Teacher-selected layer-private 2:4 matrices recover 0.8863 mean output and 0.7906 mean input-JVP energy but leave +0.6331 CE, showing useful private coordinates with missing coordinated content. Seven shared full-rank atoms reach +0.0698 LM CE at 5TPP but fail the dense-teacher endpoint because shared atoms omit layer-private ambient content. The new family holds total learned state fixed near the seven-trunk budget and reallocates it as one shared full-rank field plus a half-dense private residual in every layer.
causal_basis.not_a_sparsity_sweep: The sparsity remains exactly 2:4. No density, mask, optimizer, learning-rate, seed, step-count, or restart sweep is permitted. The only changed variable is the addition of one learned common dense base to the already sealed private 2:4 family.

family.definition: For matrix side m in {c_fc,c_proj}, W[m,l] = B[m] + S[m,l]. B[m] is one unrestricted learned matrix shared across all twelve layers. S[m,l] is layer private and has exactly two learned entries per consecutive group of four input coordinates in every row. Supports remain fixed within a fit.
family.initial_shared_base: For each coordinate, use the arithmetic mean of the twelve dense-teacher matrices. After supports are frozen, replace each base coordinate by the mean teacher value across layers whose sparse residual omits that coordinate; if every layer retains it, use the all-layer mean.
family.initial_sparse_values: On every retained coordinate, initialize S[m,l] to W_teacher[m,l] - B[m], so the initialized decomposition is the fixed-support least-squares weight approximation.

variants.name: residual_magnitude_ceiling
variants.support: Compute residuals from the all-layer teacher mean, then retain the two largest-absolute residual entries in every group of four, with stable lower-coordinate tie breaking.
variants.role: optimistic representability ceiling; cannot alone authorize LM training

variants.name: fixed_random
variants.support: For every group independently, select one of the six unordered coordinate pairs from deterministic seed 20260944 plus layer and matrix identity.

family.dense_expansion: The shared base and sparse residual may be folded and cached into ordinary per-layer dense matrices after a parameter refresh; no learned dense per-layer state is stored.

fit_protocol.objective: Equal-weight separately normalized clean-output and central-difference direction errors on dense-teacher and seven-trunk state banks.
fit_protocol.best_state_rule: Preserve the smallest discovery objective within each independent fit. Holdout and fixed-CE values never select states or masks.

report: per-variant discovery and holdout value-direction objectives
held-out output and analytic input-JVP recovery by layer and state bank
fixed-checkpoint validation CE for both supports

frozen_gates.optimization_healthy: Finite execution and either final discovery objective at most 0.5 or at least 50-percent reduction from that variant's initial objective.

decision_rule.magnitude_fail: Reject the shared-base plus private-2:4 family; do not run an LM, density sweep, or support-learning experiment.
decision_rule.magnitude_pass_random_fail: The allocation has capacity but fixed support acquisition is the blocker. Stop before LM and derive exactly one compact support-acquisition mechanism; do not tune random masks.
decision_rule.fixed_random_pass: Implement the exact fixed-random shared-base/private-2:4 family, require at least 20-percent MFU, then launch only a 124M/0.5TPP verification.
decision_rule.optimization_inconclusive: Stop and report without a capacity conclusion or LM training.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run this exact zero-LM-update nested teacher-fit factorial after focused tests and measured preflight.
not_allowed: language-model training before the fixed-random function and CE gates pass
sparsity, mask, optimizer, learning-rate, seed, step-count, or restart sweeps
using holdout values to change a support or select a state
authorization.callback_policy: Foreground-poll if measured total runtime is at most five minutes; otherwise launch one verified terminal/failure @Codex watchdog.
